newsitem.title: USA: SEC says Connecticut man bilked customers $600,000.
newsitem.headline: SEC says Connecticut man bilked customers $600,000.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday filed civil charges against a Greenwich, Connecticut man accusing him of bilking customers of more than $600,000 in cash or securities.

In its complaint filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, the agency alleged Joseph Kane Jr, 41, who is currently employed by Laidlaw Equities Inc, between January 1989 and this month, forged customer signatures, fabricated confirmation statements and made other false statements to defraud his customers.
According to the SEC's complaint, on at least one occasion, Kane repaid one defrauded customer with funds he illegally obtained from another.
Neither Kane or his attorney could be reached for comment.
Kane faces civil penalties and an order forcing him to turn over his alleged ill-gotten gains.
